message:
Partial refunds now come out right. The bug was in `src/payments/partial-refund.js`: it multiplied the amount by `percent` (0–100) without dividing by 100, so a 50% refund came out 50 times too large. It now computes `Math.round(payment.amount * percent / 100)`.

`npm test` passes all 20 tests, including `test/payments-partial-refund.test.js`. I only changed that one file.
